source_text:
domain define-business-ontology-readiness "Business Ontology readiness"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner alch-language-business-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema BusinessReadinessFacts:
  product_receipt_current: boolean
  business_questions_complete: boolean
  semantic_grounding_pass: boolean
  non_collapse_pass: boolean
  orthogonality_pass: boolean

schema BusinessReadinessDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(block|ready)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(product-receipt|business-questions|semantic-grounding|non-collapse|orthogonality|none)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping ProductReceiptBlocked:
  target BusinessReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "product-receipt"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping BusinessQuestionsBlocked:
  target BusinessReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "business-questions"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping BusinessGroundingBlocked:
  target BusinessReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "semantic-grounding"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping BusinessNonCollapseBlocked:
  target BusinessReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "non-collapse"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping BusinessOrthogonalityBlocked:
  target BusinessReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "orthogonality"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping BusinessOntologyReady:
  target BusinessReadinessDecision
  field status = "ready"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule ProductReceiptMissing:
  condition input.product_receipt_current == false

rule BusinessQuestionsIncomplete:
  condition input.product_receipt_current and input.business_questions_complete == false

rule BusinessGroundingFailed:
  condition input.product_receipt_current and input.business_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass == false

rule BusinessNonCollapseFailed:
  condition input.product_receipt_current and input.business_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass and input.non_collapse_pass == false

rule BusinessOrthogonalityFailed:
  condition input.product_receipt_current and input.business_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass and input.non_collapse_pass and input.orthogonality_pass == false

rule BusinessCanMaterialize:
  condition input.product_receipt_current and input.business_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass and input.non_collapse_pass and input.orthogonality_pass

result EvaluateBusinessOntologyReadiness:
  when ProductReceiptMissing yield ProductReceiptBlocked
  when BusinessQuestionsIncomplete yield BusinessQuestionsBlocked
  when BusinessGroundingFailed yield BusinessGroundingBlocked
  when BusinessNonCollapseFailed yield BusinessNonCollapseBlocked
  when BusinessOrthogonalityFailed yield BusinessOrthogonalityBlocked
  when BusinessCanMaterialize yield BusinessOntologyReady

endpoint DefineBusinessOntologyReadiness:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/business-ontology/readiness"
  input BusinessReadinessFacts
  output BusinessReadinessDecision
  result EvaluateBusinessOntologyReadiness
  auth-env DEFINE_RUNTIME_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status block 422
  status ready 200
